exercise.title: Turn a score into a letter grade
exercise.statement: Write get_grade(score) that returns the letter grade for an integer score from 0 to 100: 90 to 100 is "A", 80 to 89 is "B", 70 to 79 is "C", 60 to 69 is "D", and anything below 60 is "F". Return the letter as a string instead of printing it.
